title: kitchenaid dual convection toaster oven
text:
kitchenaid dual convection toaster oven. UPDATE BELOW PLEASE READ UPDATE...I'll be honest. I am sick and tired of reading reviews about exploding glass fronts, etc on toaster ovens. I had a breville for over 10 years but the new ones have scary reviews. So after months research and reading reviews I settled on this one. So far, so good. It's huge and will roast a whole chicken. I have tested the temperature with multiple devices and it is nearly perfect with a degree or two - better than any other toaster oven I have owned. The convection option is noisy - but appears to work. It makes sort of odd sounds when it's cooling down - reminds me of the sounds that my ice maker makes when it's thinking about making ice. Odd - but works. So far it is easy to clean. Learning the controls takes a minute or two, but once you get the hang of it - it's ok. I am hopeful that it will work for a long time. Having said all of that I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
UPDATE 7/6/2021 I have been using this toaster oven for several weeks and overall I am happy. If I could say one thing in the "eh" column it would be the timer bell. It needs to be WAAAAY louder. But if that's the worst I can say - it's still a good deal. I will continue to update my review if new info would be useful.
UPDATE 11/1/2021 I am devastated to write this update. The "toaster" oven no longer toasts. The bottom heating units are dead as a door nail and this thing is only 5 months old. It's junk. So, I CAN toast if I want to catch the cycle half way through and turn it. And before anyone asks - NO I am not using the "bagel" cycle! It's just a huge disappointment. You'd really like to trust the brand but I guess as with most things - it has really failed. I am so disappointed to have to shop for a new toaster/oven. Can't recommend this oven for any one unless you quite literally have money to burn.

product_metadata.title: KitchenAid Dual Convection Countertop Oven - KCO255
features: Dual convection for faster cooking - cook chicken up to 20% faster with Dual Convection Bake.* *Compared to Bake setting, 3lb chicken.
Have more control during the cooking process with the built-in temperature probe, giving you perfect cooking results time after time.
Large capacity fits up to 2 whole chickens* - enjoy more room to cook what you want - from a sheet cake to a full one-pan dinner, with the included 9x13” baking pan. *Based on 3.6 lbs weight
Enjoy full size oven functionality in a compact footprint, everyday, with 12 preset cooking functions, including everything from bake, to cookie, pizza, even dough proofing.
Turn the integrated interior light on to monitor your cooking progress through the window without disturbing your dish.
Easy to read digital display for convenient at-a-glance updates on cooking progress.
The non-stick interior and included removable metal drip and crumb tray allows you to quickly and easily clean up any spills.
Model KCO255 includes (1) Countertop Oven, (1) 9x13-inch baking pan with grill rack, (1) Removable metal drip and crumb tray, (1) Removable metal rack, (1) Temperature probe
description: Get the same possibilities as a full size oven, with quality results, in a convenient countertop size with the KitchenAid® Dual Countertop Oven with Temperature Probe. It's large capacity helps you save time and bake 2 whole chickens* at once. It also features a built-in temperature probe for more control during the cooking process, for perfect cooking results time after time. In addition, it features 12 preset cooking functions, an easy to read digital display, an interior light to check progress at any time without disrupting your dish, and a non-stick interior for quick and easy clean every time. The Dual Convect Bake setting allows you to cook up to 20% faster - compared to Bake setting; 3 lb chicken. *Based on 3.6 lbs weight.
